15:05 UTC — [INCIDENT] — Track slip near Mount Ku-ring-gai inspected. Inspector reports 300 mm of mud on the shoulder, ballast washout under the rail at the toe. Drainage pit blocked. Restriction remains 40 km/h. Crew of 3 en route with shovels and a pump. Estimated clear 17:00.

15:20 UTC — [MOVEMENT] — Freight EX4 (steel, Newcastle–Melbourne) held at Cowan for 12 min due to the slip restriction. No further delays expected.

15:40 UTC — [MAINTENANCE] — W-1151 progress: 85% complete. Wire tension re-checked after the rain band passed. One insulator found chipped, replaced. Estimated finish 16:00, report by 17:30.

16:05 UTC — [MAINTENANCE] — W-1151 closed on time. Overhead wire inspection complete. No speed restriction required after close. Report filed.

16:20 UTC — [WEATHER] — Rain band cleared. Total 9 mm recorded at Cowan. No flooding reported. Watch lifted for the low points.

16:45 UTC — [MAINTENANCE] — Track slip crew reports mud cleared, ballast re-packed, drainage pit unblocked. Speed restriction reduced to 60 km/h pending a track geometry check. Passing trains advised to expect minor delays.

17:10 UTC — [MOVEMENT] — Passenger N121 (Sydney–Newcastle) on time at Hornsby. No issues.

17:25 UTC — [INCIDENT] — Signal 22 (Cowan) reported flickering by driver of N123. Tech dispatched. Preliminary: loose connection in the signal head. Repair estimated 30 min. N123 held at Berowra, 8 min delay.

17:50 UTC — [MAINTENANCE] — Track geometry check complete. Speed restriction lifted to line speed. Crew stood down.

18:00 UTC — [MAINTENANCE] — Window W-1160 opened (scheduled 18:00–22:00). Scope: rail grinding, up main between Gosford and Tuggerah. Crew: 5, grinding machine. Single-line working in place. Speed restriction 25 km/h through the work zone.

18:10 UTC — [MOVEMENT] — Freight EX5 (intermodal, Melbourne–Brisbane) passes Gosford 5 min early. Crew advised of the grinding works; no restriction.

18:30 UTC — [INCIDENT] — Signal 22 restored at 18:20. N123 resumed, total delay 12 min.

19:00 UTC — [MAINTENANCE] — W-1160 progress: 30% complete. Grinding machine has a minor hydraulic leak, being monitored. No impact on schedule; estimated finish 21:30.

19:20 UTC — [MOVEMENT] — Passenger N125 (Sydney–Newcastle) on time at Gosford. No issues.

19:45 UTC — [RESOURCE] — Replacement hydraulic hose requested for the grinding machine. ETA 20:30 from Gosford depot. If not delivered by then, grinding will pause.

20:00 UTC — [MAINTENANCE] — W-1160 progress: 45% complete. Hose not yet arrived. Crew continuing with available sections.

20:15 UTC — [MOVEMENT] — Freight EX6 (grain, Parkes–Newcastle) passes Tuggerah 3 min late. No issues.

20:30 UTC — [RESOURCE] — Hydraulic hose delivered. Replacement underway. Estimated pause 20 min.

20:50 UTC — [MAINTENANCE] — W-1160 grinding resumed. Progress: 50% complete. Estimated finish 22:00.

21:10 UTC — [MOVEMENT] — Passenger N127 (Sydney–Newcastle) on time at Hornsby. No issues.

21:30 UTC — [MAINTENANCE] — W-1160 progress: 75% complete. No further issues. Estimated finish 21:50.

21:50 UTC — [MAINTENANCE] — W-1160 closed 10 min early. Rail grinding complete. Single-line working removed. Speed restriction lifted. Report due by 23:30.

22:00 UTC — [MOVEMENT] — Freight EX7 (coal, Hunter Valley–Port Kembla) passes Gosford on time. No issues.

22:15 UTC — [INCIDENT] — Minor trespasser reported near Wondabyne. Police notified. No trains affected.
